automated.summary: All 24 required leaves executed and passed under the Node/JUnit discriminator - the testcase name must equal the leaf id verbatim AND must not be the FILE PATH, because tools/junit-run.mjs exits 0 and names the testcase after the file when --name matches nothing (D-0024), so an exit code proves nothing. Backend hermetic suite: 224 tests, 208 pass, 0 fail, 16 skipped (the pre-existing DB-gated warehouse leaves). verify.py passes. The seam is EXTRACTED rather than duplicated: MisDrillService's controller-oriented body now returns typed ok/replaced/gone/audit-failed outcomes with the row limit as an argument, and a leaf asserts the drill controller still maps every one of them to its shipped response - so the drill route's behaviour is unchanged while the assistant reuses the same sensitive query rather than writing a second one. Three things the task grill flagged as otherwise-cosmetic are proven for real. The row limit reaches the SQL: drill-transactions hard-coded LIMIT 100 with no limit argument, so a repository-level leaf now asserts 20 and 100 genuinely differ. D-0053's race is fixed in the REAL repository as one query, tested at repository level rather than through a fake that would have passed while the race shipped. And D-0052's digest leaf now returns a DIFFERENT outline than the attested one, so the mismatch branch is actually exercised - previously the comparison could have been skipped entirely and the leaf would still have passed. The focus contract is the optional typed object the grill required: an absent focus returns the server's focus-required variant instead of being rejected by the schema, and a crafted budget subject is refused before the read seam - both impossible under task 1's required nodeKey/block pair. Decision 0025 holds: a replaced but present batch is read and reported as its own outcome carrying the full leaf explanation plus a notice naming the source and period, while only a gone batch is refused. Decision 0027 holds and is asserted on the PROVIDER PAYLOAD, not the rendered answer: no server-sourced row, amount, batch id or measure value reaches the model, while the user's own question may carry a figure - which the motivating question requires. ROUND 2: all three lenses independently raised the same defect and it was the guarantee this capability exists to make - statement-explanation.service.ts converted the drill response straight into a leaf and COPIED response.footer into it, with nothing comparing that footer to the statement amount. The required leaf named "foots in paise against the statement payload" had PASSED, which means it was asserting the footer against itself: a false green of exactly the D-0024/D-0031 kind, so the leaf was strengthened as well as the code. The comparison now runs against focusedActualPaise on the SERVER-ONLY verified context, and a mismatch returns a typed footing-mismatch refusal rather than an explanation, because transactions that do not add up to the number on screen are worse than declining. The amount is bound at ISSUE time in the attestation, not re-derived at ask time: for a replaced-but-present batch, re-deriving returns a different number than the user saw, so the check would have run against the wrong baseline. It follows the nodeMetadata pattern task 1 shipped - readable per-node paise in the response, their digest in the signed claims - so the token does not grow with the statement and altering a readable amount invalidates the context. The negative leaf uses 10000 paise against a 100.01 footer, a ONE PAISE difference, so it fails if the comparison is removed or weakened to rupees. Re-verified: 24/24 leaves pass, backend hermetic 209 pass / 0 fail / 16 pre-existing skips, verify.py green. ROUNDS 3-4: the review found two P1s that made recorded criteria UNREACHABLE rather than imperfect. The outline-membership rule task 1 introduced rejected every focused node absent from the pinned budget outline - but UNMAPPED_GL is a SYNTHETIC node that legitimately is not in the outline, which MisDrillService.prepare already allows for exactly that reason, so the unmapped-GL explanation could never fire and t-etn-c8 was unsatisfiable. The verifier now mirrors prepare() rather than carrying a second rule. Separately, ChatResponseDto was advertised as the schema for every buffered response while omitting fields ChatService visibly returns, which is worse than the description-only state decision 0019 set out to fix because a consumer gets something authoritative-looking and false; both routes now publish complete schemas. Earlier in the loop the Budget refusal was moved AHEAD of the intent branches - it had run after them, so a crafted budget subject escaped refusal whenever the question routed to causal or data first - the unmapped fallback stopped dropping the provisional flag and reason, and buildQueries lost its optional rowLimit default, the same compatibility shim the round-1 review removed from two other services. Final: 24/24 leaves pass, backend hermetic 211 pass / 0 fail / 16 pre-existing skips, verify.py green.
